diffs.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/assets/output.schema.json
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+{
+  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
+  "type": "object",
+  "required": [
+    "fit",
+    "reasons",
+    "salary_listed"
+  ],
+  "additionalProperties": false,
+  "properties": {
+    "fit": {
+      "type": "string",
+      "enum": [
+        "strong",
+        "possible",
+        "weak"
+      ]
+    },
+    "reasons": {
+      "type": "array",
+      "maxItems": 3,
+      "items": {
+        "type": "string"
+      },
+      "description": "One per preference checked."
+    },
+    "salary_listed": {
+      "type": "boolean",
+      "description": "True when the post states a salary range."
+    }
+  }
+}
